newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Jan-Mar commercial land prices fall qtr/qtr.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Jan-Mar commercial land prices fall qtr/qtr.

text.p: Commercial land prices in the greater Tokyo area fell a preliminary 2.8 percent in the January-March quarter compared with the previous quarter, a government-affiliated research body said on Friday.
The Land Institute of Japan also said that residential land prices fell 0.7 percent from the previous quarter.
In the central Tokyo area, commercial land prices fell 2.9 percent and residential land prices fell 0.9 percent.
